ashton--ashton-vsg-virgin-sun-grown.description: Ashton's fullest blend since 1999, created by Carlos Fuente Jr.: Dominican filler and binder aged four to five years, wrapped in a Sumatra-seed leaf sun-grown in Ecuador exclusively for this line. Rich and full-bodied, it is rounded out by the age of its tobacco.

thirds.notes: Pepper and cedar open with roasted espresso and a nutty edge.
Dark chocolate and leather join the coffee, with a molasses-like sweetness and roasted nuts.
Black pepper builds again over espresso, earth, cocoa and walnut.

sources.title: After Action Cigars – Ashton VSG Robusto review

ashton--ashton-classic.description: Ashton's original line, rolled at the Fuente factory in the Dominican Republic, pairs a Connecticut Shade wrapper with aged Dominican binder and long filler. It is soft and creamy, with cedar, almond and cashew over a light touch of coffee and spice: a gentle choice for the morning or an unhurried afternoon.

thirds.notes: Cream and cedar from the first puffs, with a faint sweetness; mild without feeling thin.
Toasted cashew and a little almond join the cream and cedar, and a light vanilla note settles in.
Stays clean and even to the end: cream, cedar and a soft sweetness, with no bitterness.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars

ashton--ashton-aged-maduro.description: Made at the Fuente factory in the Dominican Republic, Aged Maduro wraps matured Dominican long filler in a Connecticut Broadleaf leaf fermented for up to three years. The dark wrapper gives cocoa, molasses and a maple-like sweetness, lifted by black pepper and almond; a gentle maduro for after dinner.

thirds.notes: Black pepper first, then cocoa and cream with raisin, a hint of orange peel and some oak and earth.
Creamy caramel and toast take the lead, with orange and a deep earthiness; the body fills out.
Pepper comes back while caramel sweetness leads, with chocolate and nuts and no nicotine edge.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars

ashton--ashton-cabinet-selection.description: Cabinet Selection sets Dominican binder and filler aged five to seven years under a Connecticut Shade wrapper, made at the Fuente factory in the Dominican Republic. Close to the Classic but more layered, it brings cashew, almond and light coffee with white pepper and a vanilla-like sweetness, refined rather than forceful.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars

ashton--ashton-symmetry.description: Introduced in 2014, Symmetry was the first Ashton to use Nicaraguan tobacco: Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler and a Dominican binder under a Cuban-seed Habano Rosado wrapper grown in Ecuador, made at Tabacalera A. Fuente. It moves between cedar, cream and cocoa, with pepper, leather and a fig-like fruit note.

thirds.notes: A burst of pepper over cedar and oak, with citrus, toast and a little fruit, and leather underneath.
Cream moves forward as cocoa grows and a touch of caramel appears; leather stays in the background.
Toast and roasted nuts with cream and leather, a date-like fruit note and a floral hint as the body rises.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars

ashton--ashton-esg-estate-sun-grown.description: Estate Sun Grown was blended by Carlito Fuente to mark Ashton's twentieth anniversary, and its sizes are named as year salutes. A sun-grown Dominican rosado wrapper from the Chateau de la Fuente farm covers Dominican binder and filler. Cedar, cocoa and leather with molasses sweetness build slowly, gaining black pepper and body later on.

thirds.notes: Cedar and leather with slowly building spice and a little chocolate and coffee; mellow at first.
Chocolate and cinnamon-like spice with cream and nuts, and a sweetness that settles in.
More body, with leather more pronounced over spice, cocoa, fruit and a caramel sweetness.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars
Kohnhed – Ashton Estate Sun Grown 20 Year Salute review
Cigar Inspector – Ashton ESG 21 Year Salute

ashton--ashton-heritage-puro-sol.description: Heritage began in 2003 as Puro Sol and sets a Cuban-seed Ecuador Habano wrapper over aged Dominican binder and long filler, made at the Fuente factory in the Dominican Republic. A medium smoke of cedar and cocoa, with leather, gentle spice and a caramel-like sweetness, suited to a late afternoon.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars

ashton--ashton-small-cigars-connecticut.description: Ashton's small format in Connecticut Shade, grown in the Connecticut River Valley, over aged Dominican filler, offered in short sizes such as cigarillos. It brings the house profile to a brief smoke: almond, cashew and cedar with a light coffee note and a touch of spice.

sources.title: Holt's (Ashton distributor) – A Complete Guide for Buying Ashton Cigars
